senses.en: a device that controls water flowing from a pipe
to touch or hit something lightly
to use an available source of energy, knowledge, or resources

ex.en: Please turn off the tap while brushing your teeth.
ex.zh: 刷牙时请关上水龙头。

ex.en: Universities can tap local expertise to develop practical solutions to environmental problems affecting nearby communities.
ex.zh: 大学可以利用当地的专业知识，为影响周边社区的环境问题制定切实可行的解决方案。

col: turn off the tap｜关上水龙头
tap someone on the shoulder｜轻拍某人的肩膀
tip: 水龙头在美式英语中常称faucet。

senses.en: A narrow sticky strip used to attach or seal things.
A magnetic strip used to record sound, images, or data.
Attach or secure something using sticky tape.

ex.en: I sealed the parcel with a strip of tape.
ex.zh: 我用一条胶带封好了包裹。

ex.en: Older interviews stored on magnetic tape should be digitised to preserve valuable records for future historical research.
ex.zh: 保存在磁带上的早期访谈应进行数字化处理，为未来的历史研究保存珍贵记录。

col: a roll of tape｜一卷胶带
tip: 胶带通常不可数；一卷胶带说a roll of tape。

senses.en: A piece of work that needs to be done.
Give someone responsibility for a particular piece of work.

ex.en: My first task today is to water the plants.
ex.zh: 我今天的第一项任务是给植物浇水。

ex.en: Dividing a complex task into smaller stages can help students manage their time more effectively.
ex.zh: 把复杂任务分成较小的阶段，可以帮助学生更有效地管理时间。

col: a challenging task｜有挑战性的任务
task someone with doing something｜指派某人做某事
tip: 作动词用task sb with doing sth，表示指派任务。

senses.en: A food's flavour, or the sense that detects it.
To try food or drink, or have a particular flavour.
Someone's preferences or ability to judge what is attractive.

ex.en: The soup has a rich taste of roasted tomatoes.
ex.zh: 这汤有浓郁的烤番茄味。

ex.en: Children may develop a taste for healthier foods when schools offer varied and appealing meals.
ex.zh: 学校提供多样且诱人的餐食，可能会让孩子逐渐喜欢上更健康的食物。

tip: taste表示“尝起来”时接形容词，不接副词。

senses.en: A car with a driver whom you pay for a journey.
To move slowly on the ground before takeoff or after landing.

ex.en: We took a taxi home with our heavy bags.
ex.zh: 我们带着沉重的行李，打车回了家。

ex.en: Improving public transport could reduce dependence on taxis and private cars in crowded city centres.
ex.zh: 改善公共交通可以减少人们在拥挤的市中心对出租车和私家车的依赖。

col: hail a taxi｜招手叫出租车
tip: 乘出租车可说take a taxi或by taxi。

senses.en: a drink made by putting tea leaves in hot water
dried leaves used to make tea
a light afternoon meal or, in Britain, an early evening meal

ex.en: I made a pot of tea while you rested.
ex.zh: 你休息的时候，我泡了一壶茶。

ex.en: In many cultures, sharing tea provides an opportunity for conversation and strengthens relationships between generations.
ex.zh: 在许多文化中，一起喝茶为交谈提供了机会，也增进了代际关系。

tip: 茶水通常不可数；点单时two teas指两杯茶。

senses.en: Help someone learn knowledge, skills, or ways of behaving

ex.en: My aunt taught me how to mend a shirt.
ex.zh: 姑姑教会了我如何缝补衬衫。

ex.en: Schools should teach children how to evaluate online information rather than simply memorise facts.
ex.zh: 学校应教孩子如何评估网上的信息，而非只是死记事实。

col: teach a subject｜教授一门学科
teach someone to swim｜教某人游泳
teach a lesson｜授课；给以教训
tip: 过去式和过去分词均为taught；教某人做用teach sb to do。

senses.en: someone whose job is to help people learn

ex.en: Our teacher brought a plant into class today.
ex.zh: 我们的老师今天带了一株植物来上课。

ex.en: A well-trained teacher can adapt classroom activities to support students with different learning needs and abilities.
ex.zh: 训练有素的教师能够调整课堂活动，以帮助学习需求和能力各不相同的学生。

tip: 英语中称呼老师通常用Mr、Ms等加姓，不直接喊Teacher。

senses.en: a group working together or playing a sport together
to join someone to work together, usually with up

ex.en: Our team celebrated with pizza after winning the match.
ex.zh: 我们队赢得比赛后，吃披萨庆祝了一番。

ex.en: Working in a team helps students develop communication skills that are essential for future employment.
ex.zh: 团队合作有助于学生培养未来就业所必需的沟通能力。

tip: 英式英语中team可接单数或复数谓语。

senses.en: To pull something apart or make a hole by pulling.
A drop of liquid that comes from your eye.
A hole or split caused by pulling something apart.

ex.en: Be careful not to tear the paper bag.
ex.zh: 小心别把纸袋撕破了。

ex.en: Thin plastic bags tear easily, making them less suitable for repeated use than durable cloth alternatives.
ex.zh: 薄塑料袋容易撕裂，因此不如耐用的布袋适合反复使用。

tip: 撕裂读/teə/，眼泪读/tɪə/；动词变化为 tore、torn。

senses.en: Practical use of scientific knowledge, especially through tools and machines.

ex.en: New technology lets us control the lights from our phones.
ex.zh: 新技术让我们可以用手机控制灯光。

ex.en: Investment in clean technology can reduce industrial pollution while creating skilled jobs in emerging sectors.
ex.zh: 投资清洁技术可以减少工业污染，同时在新兴领域创造技术岗位。

tip: 泛指科技时不可数；多种具体技术可用technologies。

senses.en: A person aged thirteen to nineteen.

ex.en: As a teenager, I cycled to school every day.
ex.zh: 我十几岁时每天骑自行车上学。

ex.en: Schools should provide spaces where teenagers can discuss their concerns and receive support from trained staff.
ex.zh: 学校应提供场所，让青少年能够讨论自己的困扰，并获得受过培训的工作人员的支持。

col: a young teenager｜十三四岁的青少年
as a teenager｜在青少年时期
tip: 特指13至19岁的人，不泛指所有未成年人。

senses.en: A device or system for speaking to people far away.
To contact someone or speak to them using a phone.

ex.en: The telephone rang just as I opened the door.
ex.zh: 我刚打开门，电话就响了。

ex.en: Telephone consultations can improve access to healthcare for rural residents who live far from medical centres.
ex.zh: 电话问诊可以让远离医疗中心的农村居民更方便地获得医疗服务。

tip: telephone并非美式专用；日常通常简称phone。

senses.en: broadcast programmes with moving pictures and sound
a device used to watch broadcast or streamed programmes
the industry that produces and broadcasts television programmes

ex.en: We watched a wildlife programme on television after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后我们在电视上看了一档野生动物节目。

ex.en: Educational television can introduce children to scientific ideas that are difficult to demonstrate in classrooms.
ex.zh: 教育类电视节目可以让儿童接触难以在课堂上演示的科学概念。

tip: watch television不加冠词；指一台电视机用a television。

senses.en: Give someone information or describe something in words.
Instruct someone to do something.
Recognise a difference or know something from available evidence.

ex.en: Please tell me what happened at school today.
ex.zh: 请告诉我今天在学校发生了什么。

ex.en: Schools should tell parents how personal information about their children is collected and stored.
ex.zh: 学校应告知家长，孩子的个人信息是如何被收集和保存的。

col: tell someone to do something｜吩咐某人做某事
tip: tell常直接接人；say接人时通常用to。

senses.en: A measure of how hot or cold something is.
A body temperature higher than normal because of illness.

ex.en: The temperature dropped sharply after the sun went down.
ex.zh: 太阳落山后，气温急剧下降。

ex.en: Rising ocean temperatures can damage coral reefs and threaten the survival of many marine species.
ex.zh: 海洋温度上升会破坏珊瑚礁，并威胁许多海洋物种的生存。

col: take someone's temperature｜测量某人的体温
tip: have a temperature通常指发烧，不只是有体温。

senses.en: a building used for worship in certain religions
the flat area on either side of the forehead

ex.en: We removed our shoes before entering the temple.
ex.zh: 我们进入寺庙前脱了鞋。

ex.en: Restoring an ancient temple can preserve local heritage while attracting visitors interested in history and architecture.
ex.zh: 修复古庙既可以保护当地遗产，也能吸引对历史和建筑感兴趣的游客。

tip: 表示太阳穴时，常用复数temples指两侧。

senses.en: a sport involving hitting a ball over a net with rackets

ex.en: We play tennis at the park on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我们每逢周日都在公园打网球。

ex.en: Providing affordable tennis lessons can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop greater physical coordination.
ex.zh: 提供价格实惠的网球课程，可以鼓励年轻人经常锻炼并提高身体协调能力。

tip: 说 play tennis，不加冠词；球拍用 racket。

senses.en: A word or expression with a particular meaning.
One of the periods into which a school year is divided.
A fixed period during which something lasts or someone serves.

ex.en: Our teacher explained a scientific term using a simple drawing.
ex.zh: 老师用一幅简单的画解释了一个科学术语。

ex.en: The term sustainability describes meeting present needs without limiting the opportunities available to future generations.
ex.zh: 可持续性这一术语指满足当代需求，同时不限制后代可获得的机会。

col: in the long term｜从长远来看
tip: in terms of意为就…而言；条款义常用复数terms。

senses.en: Very bad or unpleasant.
Causing great fear, suffering, or harm.

ex.en: The soup tasted terrible, so I made a sandwich.
ex.zh: 汤很难喝，于是我做了个三明治。

ex.en: Poor waste management can have terrible consequences for public health, especially in densely populated cities.
ex.zh: 垃圾管理不善可能给公共健康带来严重后果，在人口密集的城市尤其如此。

tip: terrible是形容词；表示“非常”通常用terribly。

senses.en: a procedure that checks knowledge, ability, condition, or performance
to check what someone knows or how something performs

ex.en: I have a spelling test at school tomorrow.
ex.zh: 我明天在学校有拼写测验。

ex.en: Researchers must test new materials under different conditions before recommending their use in public buildings.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须在不同条件下测试新材料，才能建议将其用于公共建筑。

tip: 参加测验用take a test；通过测验用pass a test。

senses.en: Written words, especially the main written content of something.
A short written message sent using a phone.
Send someone a short written message using a phone.

ex.en: The text on this menu is too small.
ex.zh: 这份菜单上的字太小了。

ex.en: Teachers can combine text with images to help students understand complex scientific concepts more easily.
ex.zh: 教师可以将文字与图像结合，帮助学生更轻松地理解复杂的科学概念。

tip: 文字内容通常不可数；一条短信可说a text。

senses.en: used to introduce the second thing in a comparison
used before a clause expressing the other side of a comparison

ex.en: My new backpack is lighter than my old one.
ex.zh: 我的新背包比旧的轻。

ex.en: Investing in public transport may be more effective than building additional roads in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 在拥挤的城市，投资公共交通可能比增建道路更有效。

tip: than用于比较；then表示“然后”，注意拼写。

senses.en: used before a noun to identify something farther away
refers to something indicated, or introduces a defining relative clause
introduces a clause expressing a statement, belief, or fact

ex.en: Could you pass me that bowl beside the window?
ex.zh: 你能把窗边的那个碗递给我吗？

ex.en: Research suggests that access to green spaces can improve mental health among people living in cities.
ex.zh: 研究表明，能够接触绿地有助于改善城市居民的心理健康。

tip: 作指示词时复数为those；引导宾语从句常可省略。

senses.en: A building where people watch plays and other live performances.
The activity or art of writing, producing, and performing plays.
A specially equipped room in a hospital where operations happen.

ex.en: We arrived at the theatre just before the play started.
ex.zh: 我们在话剧开演前刚好赶到了剧院。

ex.en: Public funding for theatre can make live performances accessible to audiences who cannot afford expensive tickets.
ex.zh: 对戏剧的公共资助能让买不起高价门票的观众也有机会观看现场演出。

col: go to the theatre｜去剧院看戏
tip: 英式拼写theatre，美式常写theater；英式电影院用cinema。

senses.zh: 当时，那时；然后，后来；那么(通常用于句首或句尾)

senses.en: In, at, or towards that place.
Used before a verb to introduce something that exists.

ex.en: Leave your muddy boots there, beside the back door.
ex.zh: 把你沾满泥的靴子放在那儿，就在后门旁边。

ex.en: There are several practical ways for cities to reduce waste without increasing household expenses.
ex.zh: 城市可以采取几种切实可行的办法，在不增加家庭开支的情况下减少垃圾。

tip: there表地点或引出存在句；别与their混淆。

senses.en: Used before plural nouns for nearby people or things.
Nearby people or things, or ones just mentioned.

ex.en: These strawberries smell lovely, so let's buy a basket.
ex.zh: 这些草莓闻起来很香，我们买一篮吧。

ex.en: These findings suggest that regular outdoor activities can improve children's concentration and emotional health.
ex.zh: 这些研究结果表明，经常参加户外活动可以改善儿童的注意力和情绪健康。

col: in these circumstances｜在这些情况下
tip: these是this的复数，后接复数名词。

senses.en: having a large distance between opposite surfaces
having many things close together or being difficult to see through
flowing slowly rather than easily, like heavy cream

ex.en: She wrapped a thick blanket around her cold shoulders.
ex.zh: 她把一条厚毯子裹在冰冷的肩膀上。

ex.en: Thick layers of insulation can reduce heat loss and lower household energy bills during winter.
ex.zh: 厚厚的隔热层可以减少热量流失，降低冬季家庭能源开支。

tip: 形容液体时指黏稠，不一定表示味道浓。

senses.en: Having little distance between opposite sides or surfaces.
Having little body fat or flesh.
To make or become less dense, thick, or numerous.

ex.en: I wore a thin jacket and felt cold outside.
ex.zh: 我穿了件薄外套，在外面觉得冷。

ex.en: Thin layers of insulation can improve energy efficiency without significantly reducing the usable space inside buildings.
ex.zh: 薄层隔热材料能提高能源效率，同时不会明显减少建筑内部的可用空间。

tip: 形容身材时，thin不一定褒义；slim通常含赞美。

senses.en: an object whose name is unknown or not specified
an action, event, fact, or situation
possessions or equipment, usually referred to in the plural

ex.en: Could you move that heavy thing off my chair?
ex.zh: 你能把那个沉东西从我的椅子上搬走吗？

ex.en: One important thing governments can do is ensure that affordable housing is available near public transport.
ex.zh: 政府可以做的一件重要事情，是确保公共交通附近有可负担的住房。

col: the right thing to do｜正确的做法
first thing in the morning｜早晨第一件事
one thing at a time｜一次一件事
tip: thing很笼统；正式写作尽量换成具体名词。

senses.en: To have an opinion or belief about something.
To use your mind to consider ideas or solve problems.

ex.en: I think this soup needs a little more salt.
ex.zh: 我觉得这汤需要再加一点盐。

ex.en: Some people think that schools should devote more time to practical skills rather than examination preparation.
ex.zh: 一些人认为，学校应将更多时间用于实用技能，而不是备考。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为thought；认为时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: feeling that you need or want a drink
having a strong desire for something

ex.en: I felt thirsty after walking home in the sun.
ex.zh: 我顶着太阳走回家后觉得口渴。

ex.en: Children who are thirsty for knowledge benefit from lessons that encourage questions and independent exploration.
ex.zh: 渴求知识的孩子能从鼓励提问和自主探索的课程中受益。

tip: 表示渴望某物用thirsty for，不用thirsty of。

senses.en: an idea or opinion formed in the mind
the process of thinking carefully about something
past tense and past participle of think

ex.en: A sudden thought made me check my coat pocket.
ex.zh: 一个突然冒出的念头让我检查了一下外套口袋。

ex.en: Urban planning requires careful thought about how public spaces can serve people of different ages.
ex.zh: 城市规划需要仔细考虑公共空间如何服务不同年龄的人群。

col: give something some thought｜考虑某事
a sudden thought｜突然冒出的念头
food for thought｜引人深思的事物
tip: 表具体想法时可数；表思考过程时通常不可数。

senses.en: From one side or end to the other, within something.
By using a particular method, person, or process.
From beginning to end, or from one side to another.

ex.en: Sunlight streamed through the curtains and warmed the room.
ex.zh: 阳光透过窗帘洒进来，让房间暖和起来。

ex.en: Students can develop practical skills through projects that require cooperation and creative problem solving.
ex.zh: 学生可以通过需要合作和创造性解决问题的项目来培养实践技能。

tip: through强调从内部穿过；across强调横越表面。

senses.en: In every part of a place or during an entire period.
In every part or for the whole time.

ex.en: The smell of fresh bread spread throughout the house.
ex.zh: 新鲜面包的香味飘满了整栋房子。

ex.en: Reliable internet access throughout rural areas is essential for reducing inequalities in education and employment.
ex.zh: 在农村地区全面提供可靠的互联网接入，对减少教育和就业方面的不平等至关重要。

col: remain consistent throughout｜始终保持一致
tip: throughout强调整个范围或全程，不只是某一点。

senses.en: To send something through the air using your hand
To organise and host a party
An act of throwing, or the distance something is thrown

ex.en: Throw me the ball before the dog grabs it.
ex.zh: 趁狗还没抢到球，快把球扔给我。

ex.en: Schools can teach children to throw and catch safely through games that develop coordination and teamwork.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过培养协调能力和团队精神的游戏，教孩子安全地投接球。

tip: 不规则变化：throw–threw–thrown；聚会也可用throw。

senses.en: A paper or electronic pass allowing travel or entry.
An official notice requiring payment for a traffic offence.
To give someone an official notice for a traffic offence.

ex.en: I bought a return ticket from the station machine.
ex.zh: 我在车站的售票机上买了一张往返票。

ex.en: Lower ticket prices could encourage more commuters to choose trains instead of driving to work.
ex.zh: 降低票价可以鼓励更多通勤者选择乘火车而非开车上班。

tip: 英式single/return ticket分别指单程票和往返票。

senses.en: Neatly arranged, with everything in its proper place.
To put things in order and make a place neat.

ex.en: Her desk stays tidy, even during the busiest weeks.
ex.zh: 即使在最忙的几周里，她的书桌也保持整洁。

ex.en: Keeping shared workplaces tidy can help employees find equipment quickly and create a more pleasant environment.
ex.zh: 保持共用工作场所整洁，有助于员工迅速找到设备，并营造更舒适的环境。

tip: tidy强调摆放整齐；clean强调没有污垢。

senses.en: to fasten something using string, rope, or a knot
a long narrow piece of cloth worn around the collar
a connection between people, groups, or places

ex.en: Please tie your shoelaces before you run outside.
ex.zh: 跑出去之前，请先系好鞋带。

ex.en: Strong ties between schools and local employers can help young people make a smoother transition into work.
ex.zh: 学校与当地雇主之间的紧密联系，可以帮助年轻人更顺利地进入职场。

tip: tie的现在分词是tying；表示关系时通常用复数ties。

senses.en: A large wild cat with dark stripes on orange fur

ex.en: The tiger rested in the shade beside a pool.
ex.zh: 那只老虎在水池旁的阴凉处休息。

ex.en: Protecting tiger habitats also helps conserve other species that share the same forest ecosystems.
ex.zh: 保护老虎栖息地也有助于保护同一森林生态系统中的其他物种。

tip: 可数名词；一只老虎用a tiger。

senses.en: up to a particular time
up to the time when something happens
a machine or drawer where a shop keeps cash

ex.en: The little bakery stays open till six every evening.
ex.zh: 这家小面包店每天晚上营业到六点。

ex.en: Some parents work till late evening, making affordable childcare essential for families in urban areas.
ex.zh: 有些家长工作到深夜，因此价格可负担的托育服务对城市家庭至关重要。

tip: till与until意思相同；作连词谈将来时通常接一般现在时。

senses.en: what clocks measure, or a particular point in its passage
an occasion when something happens
to measure duration or choose when something should happen

ex.en: We still have time for a walk before dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭前我们还有时间散步。

ex.en: Schools should give students enough time to explore creative activities alongside their preparation for formal examinations.
ex.zh: 学校应在学生准备正式考试的同时，给予他们足够的时间探索创意活动。

col: spend time doing something｜花时间做某事
tip: 时间通常不可数；表示次数时可数，如three times。

senses.en: a useful piece of advice
the narrow or pointed end of something
extra money given to someone for providing a service

ex.en: My neighbour shared a useful tip for growing tomatoes.
ex.zh: 邻居分享了一个种番茄的实用窍门。

ex.en: Schools can offer practical tips on managing money to help young people develop responsible spending habits.
ex.zh: 学校可以提供实用的理财建议，帮助年轻人养成负责任的消费习惯。

col: the tip of the tongue｜舌尖
tip: tip作“建议”可数，advice不可数：a tip。

senses.en: needing rest or sleep because of physical or mental effort
annoyed or bored by something that continues or repeats

ex.en: I felt too tired to cook after the walk.
ex.zh: 散步后我累得不想做饭。

ex.en: Employees who regularly work long hours may become too tired to perform their duties safely.
ex.zh: 经常长时间工作的员工可能会疲惫不堪，无法安全地履行职责。

col: too tired to concentrate｜累得无法集中注意力
tip: tired形容人感到累；tiring形容事情令人累。

senses.en: the name given to a book, film, or other work
a name indicating someone's rank, position, or professional role
the position of winner in a sporting competition

ex.en: I remember the book's cover but not its title.
ex.zh: 我记得这本书的封面，却不记得书名了。

ex.en: An effective essay title should clearly indicate the main issue being discussed without revealing every detail.
ex.zh: 好的文章标题应清楚表明所讨论的主要问题，而不必透露所有细节。

tip: title是标题或名称；topic是讨论的主题。

senses.zh: (表示接受动作的人或物)给……；对……，向……，到……

senses.en: on this day, or during the present period
the current day or the present period

ex.en: Let's eat outside today while the weather is warm.
ex.zh: 今天天气暖和，我们到外面吃饭吧。

ex.en: Today, many universities offer flexible courses that allow students to combine employment with further education.
ex.zh: 如今，许多大学开设灵活的课程，让学生能够兼顾工作和继续教育。

tip: today既可指今天，也可泛指当今；前面不用on。

senses.en: with another person or other people
joined or combined with something else

ex.en: We cooked dinner together and shared stories about our day.
ex.zh: 我们一起做晚饭，分享各自一天的见闻。

ex.en: Schools and families should work together to help children develop healthy habits from an early age.
ex.zh: 学校和家庭应共同努力，帮助孩子从小养成健康习惯。

tip: together通常作副词：一起做某事用动词加together。

senses.en: a soft, juicy fruit often eaten as a vegetable

ex.en: She sliced a ripe tomato for her cheese sandwich.
ex.zh: 她切了一个熟番茄，放进奶酪三明治里。

ex.en: Growing tomatoes in community gardens can improve access to fresh food in urban neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 在社区花园种植番茄，可以让城市居民更容易获得新鲜食物。

tip: 复数是tomatoes；英美发音的重读元音不同。

senses.en: On the day after today.
The day after today, or the future more generally.

ex.en: We are meeting at the swimming pool tomorrow morning.
ex.zh: 我们明天早上在游泳池见面。

ex.en: The environmental decisions made today will shape the world that the children of tomorrow inherit.
ex.zh: 今天作出的环境决策将塑造未来孩子们继承的世界。

tip: tomorrow前通常不加on；明早是tomorrow morning。

senses.en: during the evening or night of today
the evening or night of today

ex.en: We are making vegetable soup for dinner tonight.
ex.zh: 我们今晚要做蔬菜汤当晚餐。

ex.en: Residents will meet tonight to discuss how public transport could better serve the local community.
ex.zh: 居民们今晚将开会讨论公共交通如何更好地服务当地社区。

tip: 作时间状语时直接用tonight，前面不加介词。

senses.en: more than is wanted, needed, or suitable
in addition; also

ex.en: This soup is too hot to eat now.
ex.zh: 这汤现在太烫，还不能喝。

ex.en: Public transport cannot attract more passengers if fares are too high for regular commuters.
ex.zh: 如果票价对日常通勤者而言过高，公共交通就无法吸引更多乘客。

col: too tired to work｜累得无法工作
tip: too强调超过合适程度；very只强调程度高。

senses.en: An object used to build, repair, or make things.
Something that helps you perform a task or achieve something.

ex.en: This small tool helps me tighten the loose screws.
ex.zh: 这个小工具帮我拧紧松动的螺丝。

ex.en: Digital maps are a valuable tool for urban planners seeking to design more accessible public transport networks.
ex.zh: 数字地图是城市规划者设计更便捷的公共交通网络的重要辅助工具。

col: a tool for learning｜学习工具
tip: tool是可数名词；equipment通常不可数。

senses.en: a hard structure in the mouth used for biting and chewing
a pointed part of a tool, comb or wheel

ex.en: The dentist checked each tooth with a small mirror.
ex.zh: 牙医用一面小镜子检查了每颗牙齿。

ex.en: Regular dental checkups can help prevent tooth decay and reduce the need for expensive treatment.
ex.zh: 定期牙科检查有助于预防蛀牙，减少接受昂贵治疗的需要。

tip: 复数是不规则形式teeth，注意元音也变化。

senses.en: pain in a tooth or the surrounding area

ex.en: My toothache kept me awake for most of the night.
ex.zh: 牙痛让我大半夜都没睡着。

ex.en: Affordable dental services allow people with toothache to seek treatment before more serious problems develop.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的牙科服务让牙痛患者能在问题恶化前就医。

tip: 英式常说have toothache，美式常说have a toothache。

senses.en: the highest part or surface of something
highest in position, rank, or quality
to rank highest or be greater than something

ex.en: She placed the star on top of the tree.
ex.zh: 她把那颗星星放在树顶上。

ex.en: Improving access to affordable housing should be a top priority for governments facing rapid urban population growth.
ex.zh: 对于面临城市人口快速增长的政府来说，改善居民获得可负担住房的机会应是首要任务。

tip: on top of指在上面；at the top of指在顶端。

senses.en: a subject that people discuss, write about, or study

ex.en: Food is always a popular topic in our house.
ex.zh: 食物在我们家一直是个热门话题。

ex.en: Climate change has become a central topic in school discussions about the future of our planet.
ex.zh: 气候变化已成为学校讨论地球未来时的核心话题。

col: a topic of discussion｜讨论的话题
a controversial topic｜有争议的话题
tip: topic指讨论或写作的主题；title指文章等的标题。

senses.en: to put your hand or another body part against something
the sense of feeling things through skin, or physical contact
to make someone feel a strong, often tender emotion

ex.en: Please don't touch the pan; it is still hot.
ex.zh: 请别碰锅，它还很烫。

ex.en: Digital communication helps families stay in touch, even when work or study separates them across countries.
ex.zh: 即使工作或学习使家人分居不同国家，数字通信也能帮助他们保持联系。

tip: 保持联系用keep in touch with someone。

senses.en: A journey visiting several places, or a guided visit somewhere.
A series of performances or matches held in different places.
To travel around places for sightseeing, performances, or other activities.

ex.en: We took a guided tour of the old castle.
ex.zh: 我们在导游带领下参观了那座古堡。

ex.en: Organized tours can introduce visitors to local traditions while providing reliable income for community guides.
ex.zh: 有组织的游览既能让游客了解当地传统，也能为社区导游提供稳定收入。

col: guided tour｜有导游带领的游览
go on tour｜进行巡回活动
tip: tour强调参观或多站行程；trip泛指一次出行。

senses.en: Someone who visits places for pleasure rather than work

ex.en: A tourist asked me how to reach the castle.
ex.zh: 一位游客问我怎么去城堡。

ex.en: Large numbers of tourists support local businesses but can also place pressure on public transport.
ex.zh: 大量游客为当地企业带来生意，但也可能给公共交通造成压力。

tip: tourist通常是名词，在tourist attraction中修饰名词。

senses.en: In the direction of someone or something
In relation to someone or something, especially attitudes or behaviour
Helping to achieve or pay for something

ex.en: The puppy ran toward me with a muddy ball.
ex.zh: 小狗叼着一个沾满泥的球向我跑来。

ex.en: Investment in public transport is an important step toward reducing traffic congestion and improving urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通是缓解交通拥堵、改善城市空气质量的重要一步。

col: go toward the cost｜用于支付费用
tip: toward与towards同义；前者美式更常用。

senses.en: a tall, narrow structure, standing alone or on a building
rise much higher than nearby people or things

ex.en: We climbed the tower and watched boats cross the bay.
ex.zh: 我们爬上塔，看着船只驶过海湾。

ex.en: The historic tower attracts visitors throughout the year, providing valuable income for nearby shops and restaurants.
ex.zh: 这座历史悠久的塔全年吸引着游客，为附近的商店和餐馆带来可观收入。

tip: 作动词常接over或above，表示远高于周围事物。

senses.en: A settlement usually larger than a village but smaller than a city
The central area where people go shopping or do business

ex.en: Our town has a bakery beside the old bridge.
ex.zh: 我们镇的老桥旁有一家面包店。

ex.en: Improving public transport in a small town can help residents access jobs and essential services.
ex.zh: 改善小城镇的公共交通可以帮助居民获得就业机会和基本服务。

tip: go into town指去市中心，此时town前不加冠词。

senses.en: An object that children use for play.
To handle casually or consider without serious commitment.

ex.en: The baby dropped her toy behind the sofa.
ex.zh: 宝宝把她的玩具掉到了沙发后面。

ex.en: Well-designed toys can encourage young children to develop practical skills through creative play and exploration.
ex.zh: 设计精良的玩具可以鼓励幼儿通过创意游戏和探索来培养实践技能。

col: toy with an idea｜随意考虑一个想法
tip: 动词常用toy with；toy with an idea指并不认真地考虑。

senses.en: A belief or custom passed down through generations.

ex.en: Making dumplings together is a tradition in our family.
ex.zh: 一起包饺子是我们家的传统。

ex.en: Schools can help preserve local traditions by inviting older residents to share their knowledge and practical skills.
ex.zh: 学校可以邀请年长居民分享知识和实用技能，从而帮助保留当地传统。

tip: 具体习俗可数；泛指传统时可不可数，如break with tradition。

senses.en: Following customs or methods passed down over a long time.

ex.en: We cooked a traditional meal for the family gathering.
ex.zh: 我们为家庭聚会做了一顿传统饭菜。

ex.en: Traditional farming methods can preserve local knowledge, although some require adaptation to cope with climate change.
ex.zh: 传统耕作方法能够保留地方知识，但其中一些需要调整以应对气候变化。

tip: traditional强调传承已久，不一定表示落后。

senses.en: Vehicles moving along roads in a particular area
The amount of data or messages passing through a system

ex.en: Heavy traffic made us late for dinner again.
ex.zh: 交通拥堵又让我们吃晚饭迟到了。

ex.en: Investing in reliable public transport can reduce traffic congestion and improve urban air quality.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以缓解交通拥堵，并改善城市空气质量。

tip: 表示交通或车流时不可数，不说a traffic。

senses.en: Connected railway vehicles that carry passengers or goods.
Teach or practise skills needed for an activity or job.

ex.en: We caught the last train home after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们赶上了回家的末班火车。

ex.en: Governments should train more healthcare workers to meet the needs of an ageing population.
ex.zh: 政府应培训更多医护人员，以满足老龄化人口的需求。

col: train for a marathon｜为马拉松训练
tip: 交通方式用by train；在某列火车上用on the train。

senses.en: To express words or writing in another language
To change something into a different form or practical result

ex.en: Could you translate this recipe into English for me?
ex.zh: 你能帮我把这份食谱翻译成英语吗？

ex.en: Governments must translate environmental commitments into practical policies that encourage businesses to reduce emissions.
ex.zh: 政府必须把环保承诺转化为切实的政策，鼓励企业减少排放。

col: translate ideas into action｜将想法付诸行动
tip: 从某语言译成另一语言：translate from…into…。

senses.en: Vehicles or systems used to move people and goods.
To move people or goods from one place to another.

ex.en: We rely on public transport to get around town.
ex.zh: 我们在城里出行靠公共交通。

ex.en: Better transport links between rural areas and cities can expand employment opportunities for local residents.
ex.zh: 改善乡村与城市之间的交通联系可以为当地居民增加就业机会。

tip: 上列为名词音标；动词重音后移，英/t/前为/n/。

senses.en: To go from one place to another.
The activity of going to other places.
To move or spread from one place to another.

ex.en: We usually travel by train to visit our grandparents.
ex.zh: 我们通常坐火车去看望祖父母。

ex.en: Affordable public transport enables residents to travel more sustainably and reduces dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 价格合理的公共交通让居民能够以更可持续的方式出行，并减少对私家车的依赖。

tip: 泛指旅行时travel不可数；一次旅行用a trip。

senses.en: A tall plant with a wooden trunk and branches.

ex.en: A small bird built its nest in our tree.
ex.zh: 一只小鸟在我们家的树上筑了巢。

ex.en: Planting trees in urban areas provides shade, improves air quality, and creates valuable habitats for wildlife.
ex.zh: 在城市地区植树能提供树荫、改善空气质量，并为野生动物创造宝贵的栖息地。

tip: tree是树；wood可指木材，woods通常指树林。

senses.en: an action intended to deceive someone or make them look foolish
a clever technique or an act that seems magical
to deceive someone into believing or doing something

ex.en: Someone played a trick on me with a plastic spider.
ex.zh: 有人用一只塑料蜘蛛捉弄了我。

ex.en: Some online advertisements trick consumers into paying for services they initially believed were free.
ex.zh: 一些网络广告诱骗消费者为他们起初以为免费的服务付费。

col: play a trick on someone｜捉弄某人
trick someone into doing something｜骗某人做某事
the trick to doing something｜做某事的窍门
tip: trick sb into doing sth表示“骗某人做某事”。

senses.en: a journey to a place and usually back again
to stumble or make someone stumble by catching a foot

ex.en: Our weekend trip to the coast was wonderfully relaxing.
ex.zh: 我们周末的海滨之旅让人十分放松。

ex.en: School trips to museums can enrich classroom learning by giving students direct access to historical objects.
ex.zh: 学校组织的博物馆参观能让学生直接接触历史实物，从而丰富课堂学习。

tip: trip 是可数名词；travel 表示旅行活动时通常不可数。

senses.en: problems or difficulties that cause worry or inconvenience
to cause someone worry or ask them for help

ex.en: We had trouble opening the stiff kitchen window.
ex.zh: 厨房的窗户很紧，我们费了好大劲才打开。

ex.en: Many older adults have trouble accessing public services that are available only through digital platforms.
ex.zh: 许多老年人难以使用那些仅通过数字平台提供的公共服务。

col: have trouble doing something｜做某事有困难
take the trouble to do something｜费心做某事
tip: 表示做某事有困难，用have trouble doing。

senses.en: Clothing covering the waist and legs, with separate leg sections.

ex.en: These trousers are too long, so I need them shortened.
ex.zh: 这条裤子太长了，我需要把它改短。

ex.en: Some employers require staff to wear formal trousers, while others allow more casual clothing in the workplace.
ex.zh: 一些雇主要求员工穿正式长裤，另一些则允许员工在工作场所穿得更休闲。

col: a pair of trousers｜一条长裤
tip: 用复数：trousers are；一条用a pair of trousers。

senses.en: matching the facts rather than being false or invented
having the essential qualities expected of someone or something
remaining loyal to a person, belief, or principle

ex.en: Is it TRUE that your cat can open doors?
ex.zh: 你的猫会开门，这是真的吗？

ex.en: Students must assess whether online claims are TRUE before using them as evidence in academic essays.
ex.zh: 学生在将网上的说法用作学术论文的论据之前，必须评估其是否属实。

col: true to your word｜信守诺言
tip: true强调符合事实；real强调实际存在。

senses.en: A large road vehicle used for carrying goods.
To transport goods by truck.

ex.en: A truck delivered fresh vegetables to the market this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，一辆卡车把新鲜蔬菜送到了市场。

ex.en: Transporting goods by truck offers flexibility, but rail freight can reduce emissions over longer distances.
ex.zh: 用卡车运输货物较为灵活，但长途铁路货运能减少排放。

tip: truck常用于美式英语，英式英语常用lorry。

senses.en: Belief that someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe.
To believe someone or something is honest, reliable, or safe.
An arrangement or organisation managing money or property for others.

ex.en: I trust my neighbour to feed our cat.
ex.zh: 我信得过邻居，放心让他喂我们的猫。

ex.en: Public trust in scientific advice depends partly on how clearly researchers communicate uncertainty and evidence.
ex.zh: 公众对科学建议的信任，部分取决于研究人员能否清晰地说明不确定性和证据。

col: trust someone to do something｜相信某人会做某事
a charitable trust｜慈善信托机构
tip: trust sb to do sth表示相信某人能可靠地做某事。

senses.en: what is real or actually happened
a fact or principle generally accepted as true

ex.en: Please tell me the truth about the broken cup.
ex.zh: 请告诉我杯子打碎的真相。

ex.en: Journalists should seek the truth rather than publish stories that simply attract public attention.
ex.zh: 记者应当寻求真相，而不是发表仅仅吸引公众注意的报道。

col: the truth about something｜关于某事的真相
tip: 说实话用tell the truth，通常不能省略the。

senses.en: make an effort to do something
use or do something to see whether it works
an attempt to do something

ex.en: I'll try to fix the lamp before dinner.
ex.zh: 我会试着在晚饭前把灯修好。

ex.en: Schools should try different teaching methods to meet the needs of students with varying abilities.
ex.zh: 学校应尝试不同的教学方法，以满足能力各异的学生的需求。

col: try to do something｜努力做某事
tip: try to do强调努力；try doing强调试试办法。

senses.en: A large bird often raised for its meat
Meat from a turkey, eaten as food
Something that fails badly, especially a film or play

ex.en: A turkey spread its tail feathers near the farm gate.
ex.zh: 一只火鸡在农场大门旁展开了尾羽。

ex.en: Turkey production provides affordable protein, but intensive farming can raise concerns about animal welfare and environmental damage.
ex.zh: 火鸡养殖提供了价格实惠的蛋白质，但集约化养殖可能引发对动物福利和环境破坏的担忧。

tip: 鸟可数，肉不可数；表示失败之作时属非正式用法。

senses.en: Move around a centre or change direction.
Change to a different state, colour, or condition.
An opportunity to do something in an agreed order.

ex.en: Turn the handle gently and pull the door towards you.
ex.zh: 轻轻转动把手，然后朝自己这边拉门。

ex.en: As populations age, governments must turn their attention to accessible housing and community healthcare.
ex.zh: 随着人口老龄化，政府必须将注意力转向无障碍住房和社区医疗。

tip: 表示变得时，turn后接形容词；turn into后接名词。

senses.en: On two occasions.
To double the amount, degree, or size.

ex.en: I checked my bag twice but couldn't find my keys.
ex.zh: 我检查了两次包，却没找到钥匙。

ex.en: Residents who exercise at least twice a week may experience improvements in their physical and mental health.
ex.zh: 每周至少锻炼两次的居民，身心健康可能得到改善。

tip: 两倍常用twice as…as或twice the＋名词。

senses.en: One of two children born to the same mother together.
Forming a matching pair, or relating to twins.

ex.en: My twin and I share a love of swimming.
ex.zh: 我的双胞胎手足和我都喜欢游泳。

ex.en: Studies involving identical twins help researchers understand how genes and environment influence human development.
ex.zh: 涉及同卵双胞胎的研究有助于研究人员了解基因和环境如何影响人的发育。

tip: a twin指双胞胎中的一人；twins指两人。

senses.en: a group of things sharing particular features
to enter words using a keyboard

ex.en: What type of bread would you like today?
ex.zh: 你今天想要哪种面包？

ex.en: Different types of public transport are needed to serve both urban and rural communities.
ex.zh: 城市和农村社区都需要不同类型的公共交通服务。

col: type a message｜打字输入消息
tip: type of后接名词；表示多种类型用types of。

senses.en: a folding cover on a stick protecting against rain or sun
including several different groups, activities, or ideas

ex.en: We shared an umbrella on the walk home.
ex.zh: 走路回家时，我们共撑一把伞。

ex.en: An umbrella organisation can help small charities coordinate their activities and share resources more effectively.
ex.zh: 一个联合组织可以帮助小型慈善机构协调活动，更有效地共享资源。

tip: umbrella term指涵盖多个相关概念的统称。

senses.en: a parent's brother or an aunt's husband

ex.en: My uncle taught me how to mend a bicycle.
ex.zh: 我叔叔教过我怎样修自行车。

ex.en: An uncle or aunt can provide valuable emotional support when parents are busy with work commitments.
ex.zh: 父母忙于工作时，叔伯姑姨等亲属可以提供宝贵的情感支持。

col: uncle and aunt｜叔伯姑姨等亲属
tip: uncle不区分父母哪一方，也不区分长幼。

senses.en: in or into a position below something
less than a particular amount, age, or level
experiencing a condition or being controlled by someone or something

ex.en: The cat curled up under the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 猫蜷缩在厨房的桌子下面。

ex.en: Under the new policy, local authorities must provide safer cycling routes near schools and residential areas.
ex.zh: 根据新政策，地方政府必须在学校和住宅区附近提供更安全的骑行路线。

col: under the age of｜年龄不满
tip: under可表位置、数量或状态：under pressure。

senses.en: Below the ground, or operating secretly.
Below the ground, or in a hidden, secret way.
A railway system running mainly beneath a city.

ex.en: We left our car in an underground garage.
ex.zh: 我们把车停在了地下车库。

ex.en: Underground transport systems can ease congestion, although constructing tunnels requires substantial investment and careful planning.
ex.zh: 地铁交通系统能缓解拥堵，但隧道建设需要大量投资和周密规划。

tip: 名词表地铁主要用于英式英语，此时重音在首音节。

senses.en: to know what something means or how it works
to recognise why someone feels or behaves a certain way
to believe something is true based on available information

ex.en: I finally understand how to use this washing machine.
ex.zh: 我终于懂得怎么用这台洗衣机了。

ex.en: Schools should help students understand how their daily choices affect the natural environment.
ex.zh: 学校应帮助学生理解自己的日常选择如何影响自然环境。

tip: 过去式和过去分词均为understood。

senses.en: not treating people equally or reasonably

ex.en: It seems unfair that I always wash the dishes.
ex.zh: 总是让我洗碗，这似乎不公平。

ex.en: Unfair hiring practices can prevent qualified applicants from accessing employment opportunities and reduce diversity in the workplace.
ex.zh: 不公平的招聘做法可能使合格的求职者失去就业机会，并降低职场的多样性。

col: unfair to someone｜对某人不公平
tip: 表示“对某人不公平”用unfair to someone。

senses.en: so special or powerful that you will always remember it

ex.en: Watching whales from the boat was an unforgettable experience.
ex.zh: 在船上看鲸鱼是一次难忘的经历。

ex.en: School trips can provide unforgettable experiences that strengthen students' understanding of history beyond the classroom.
ex.zh: 学校组织的旅行能带来难忘的体验，让学生在课堂之外加深对历史的理解。

tip: 形容经历令人难忘；forgetful指人健忘。

senses.en: used to say that something is disappointing or unlucky

ex.en: Unfortunately, the bakery had sold out of fresh bread.
ex.zh: 遗憾的是，面包店的新鲜面包已经卖完了。

ex.en: Unfortunately, many rural schools lack the resources needed to provide students with reliable internet access.
ex.zh: 遗憾的是，许多乡村学校缺乏为学生提供可靠网络连接所需的资源。

col: unfortunately for someone｜对某人来说不幸的是
unfortunately not｜遗憾的是并非如此
tip: 常置于句首并加逗号，对整件事表示遗憾。
